# agent-ui-kit

Point at an element in a running app, say what is wrong; the note is appended to a Markdown file that a coding agent reads.

- Vite dev-server plugin, dev only, zero dependencies, MIT.
- Install: npm i -D agent-ui-kit; add agentUiKit() to plugins in vite.config.
- Notes go to NOTES.md by default: component chain, tag, classes, id, data-testid, page, time.
- Docs: https://github.com/arsen-ask-lx/agent-ui-kit#readme
- Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/agent-ui-kit
